record.original_question: Given a metric space (X, d), characterize when the Wijsman hyperspace (2^X, T_W(d)) is a Baire space, using properties of the underlying metric space (X, d).

evidence.quote: Problem 4.1. Let (X, d) be a metric space. Find characterizations for (2^X, T_W(d)) to be a Baire space, in terms of some properties of (X, d).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,d)$ be a metric space, and let $2^X$ denote the collection of all nonempty closed subsets of $X$. The Wijsman topology $\tau_W(d)$ on $2^X$ is the weakest topology for which, for each fixed $x \in X$, the distance functional
$$d_x : 2^X \to \mathbb{R}, \qquad d_x(A) = \inf\{d(x,a) : a \in A\}$$
is continuous. Recall that a topological space is a Baire space if the intersection of every countable family of dense open sets is dense (equivalently, no nonempty open set is of the first category).

Problem: Find a characterization, expressed purely in terms of properties of $(X,d)$, of those metric spaces $(X,d)$ for which the Wijsman hyperspace $(2^X, \tau_W(d))$ is a Baire space.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing Baireness of the Wijsman hyperspace in terms of properties of the underlying metric space (X,d) appears to remain open. Partial results are known: completeness of (X,d) implies Baireness of the Wijsman hyperspace; Zsilinszky and others gave characterizations under additional assumptions (e.g., metrizable base with a countable-in-itself π-base); and Pol–Zsilinszky exhibited a first-category metric space whose Wijsman hyperspace is Baire. Whether the Wijsman hyperspace of every metric Baire space is Baire is still an open question, and no full characterization has been found.

status_evidence.title: On Baireness of the Wijsman Hyperspace (Zsilinszky)
status_evidence.snippet: Baireness of the Wijsman hyperspace topology characterized for a metrizable base space with a countable-in-itself π-base; first-category metric space with Baire Wijsman hyperspace constructed.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial characterizations are known; the general characterization in terms of (X,d) is not established.

status_evidence.title: Amsterdam properties of Wijsman hyperspaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies completeness-type (Amsterdam) properties of Wijsman hyperspaces, related to the Baire property.
status_evidence.claim: Research line continues; no full characterization of Baireness is provided.

status_evidence.title: Three open problems on the Wijsman hyperspace
status_evidence.snippet: Lists characterization of Baireness of the Wijsman hyperspace as an open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as open.
